description: Confucius4-TTS is a multilingual voice-cloning TTS model packaged for audio.cpp with offline and streaming generation. It uses reference speech, language-aware text normalization, T2S semantic generation, S2A flow matching, style encoding, semantic audio features, and BigVGAN vocoding.

request.name: language
request.description: Target synthesis language code used by the text frontend; default zh when no request transcript language or style language is provided.

request.name: temperature
request.description: T2S sampling temperature; must be positive, default 0.8.

request.name: top_p
request.description: T2S nucleus sampling probability; must be in (0, 1], default 0.8.

request.name: top_k
request.description: T2S top-k sampling limit; must be positive, default 30.

request.name: repetition_penalty
request.description: T2S repetition penalty; must be positive, default 10.0.

request.name: max_tokens
request.description: Maximum T2S semantic sequence length including prompt tokens; default 1520.

request.name: cross_fade_duration_sec
request.description: Cross-fade duration between generated segments in seconds; default 0.3.

request.name: edge_fade_duration_sec
request.description: Fade duration applied at segment edges in seconds; default 0.1.

request.name: edge_pad_duration_sec
request.description: Silence padding applied at segment edges in seconds; default 0.1.

request.name: seed
request.description: Seed for T2S sampling and S2A noise initialization; default 1234.

session.name: graph_arena_mb
session.description: Reusable ggml graph arena size in MiB for Confucius stages; default 512.

session.name: weight_context_mb
session.description: Weight loading context size in MiB; default 1024.

session.name: weight_type
session.description: Matmul weight storage type; default native.

session.name: conv_weight_type
session.description: Convolution weight storage type; default native.

session.name: reference_cache_slots
session.description: Prepared reference-audio cache slots; default 1, set 0 to disable caching.

session.name: mem_saver
session.description: Release staged graphs after request phases; default false.

sizes.basis: size=tree@huggingface; hf_mirror=assumed; modelscope=files API; est_vram=size lower bound (no measurement)

description.en: Confucius4-TTS is a multilingual voice-cloning TTS model packaged for audio.cpp with offline and streaming generation. It uses reference speech, language-aware text normalization, T2S semantic generation, S2A flow matching, style encoding, semantic audio features, and BigVGAN vocoding.
description.zh: Confucius4-TTS 是面向 audio.cpp 打包的多语言音色克隆 TTS 模型，支持离线与流式生成。使用参考语音、语言感知文本归一化、T2S 语义生成、S2A 流匹配、风格编码、语义音频特征与 BigVGAN 声码。

language.en: Target synthesis language code used by the text frontend; default zh when no request transcript language or style language is provided.
language.zh: 文本前端使用的目标合成语言代码；未提供转写语言或风格语言时默认 zh。

temperature.en: T2S sampling temperature; must be positive, default 0.8.
temperature.zh: T2S 采样温度，须为正数，默认 0.8。

top_p.en: T2S nucleus sampling probability; must be in (0, 1], default 0.8.
top_p.zh: T2S 核采样概率，取值 (0, 1]，默认 0.8。

top_k.en: T2S top-k sampling limit; must be positive, default 30.
top_k.zh: T2S top-k 采样上限，须为正数，默认 30。

repetition_penalty.en: T2S repetition penalty; must be positive, default 10.0.
repetition_penalty.zh: T2S 重复惩罚，须为正数，默认 10.0。

max_tokens.en: Maximum T2S semantic sequence length including prompt tokens; default 1520.
max_tokens.zh: T2S 语义序列最大长度（含提示 token），默认 1520。

guidance_scale.zh: S2A 无分类器引导强度，默认 0.7。

cross_fade_duration_sec.en: Cross-fade duration between generated segments in seconds; default 0.3.
cross_fade_duration_sec.zh: 生成分段之间的交叉淡入淡出时长（秒），默认 0.3。

edge_fade_duration_sec.en: Fade duration applied at segment edges in seconds; default 0.1.
edge_fade_duration_sec.zh: 分段边缘的淡入淡出时长（秒），默认 0.1。

edge_pad_duration_sec.en: Silence padding applied at segment edges in seconds; default 0.1.
edge_pad_duration_sec.zh: 分段边缘填充的静音时长（秒），默认 0.1。

seed.en: Seed for T2S sampling and S2A noise initialization; default 1234.
seed.zh: T2S 采样与 S2A 噪声初始化的随机种子，默认 1234。
